content.title: Xbox Now Has Three Games Scheduled For Game Pass On The Final Day Of April
content.text: Another one just got announced Anyone else finding it hard to keep up with all the Xbox Game Pass announcements this month?! There are now 26 games (!) on our list of all Xbox Game Pass titles coming in April 2026, and some of them have very much gone under the radar in recent weeks — including all three of the games that have been announced for the final day of April. Before we get there, you should know that there's still a lot to come in the weeks ahead, including Call of Duty: Modern Warfare on Friday, Vampire Crawlers and Kiln next week, Aphelion on the 28th, and various other exciting additions. If we're talking about just the final day of April though, Microsoft hasn't actually mentioned any of these yet in an official XGP roundup — we've got Heroes of Might and Magic: Olden Era coming to PC Game Pass alone, while Sledding Game and TerraTech Legion are both console and PC additions... they're all arriving on April 30th. TerraTech Legion is actually a brand-new announcement for Xbox Game Pass, having just been revealed for the service literally just over an hour ago. The game is a "survivors-like vehicular action roguelike" that will specifically be available for Xbox Game Pass Ultimate and PC Game Pass members when it arrives. We'll drop closer looks at all three of these games down below, along with some descriptions for each. Don't forget about everything else still to come this month though, along with the Game Pass titles confirmed for May so far! Heroes of Might and Magic: Olden Era (PC) Heroes of Might and Magic: Olden Era is the official prequel hailing back to the origins of the genre-defining, critically acclaimed series of turn-based strategy games. Raise grand armies and wield devastating spells to overcome your foes in both solo and multiplayer. Sledding Game (Console & PC) Sledding Game is a multiplayer snowsports hangout game with proximity chat. Go sledding, relax and see what else there is to do. There’s also ragdoll physics so the crashes look terrible really really good. TerraTech Legion (Console & PC) Build the ultimate battle vehicle and rage against the machines in a chaotic Bullet Heaven Builder. Master a deep, block-based vehicle-building system to survive an army of robotic foes driven by a crazed AI, ramming them at speed and shooting infinite projectiles. Liking the look of any of these three games in particular? Tell us down in the comments section below. Fraser is the News Editor at Pure Xbox, where he spends his time reporting on the biggest stories in the world of Xbox and beyond. Author Profile Reply
